Skytruth Analysis
TO THE BEST OF MY KNOWLEDGE THE COMPANY HAS BEEN BURNING PAINTED (AND POTENTIALLY TREATED) WOOD PIER SECTIONS IN AN OUTDOOR WOOD FURNACE TO HEAT THEIR BUILDING. THEY HAVE BEEN DOING THIS DAY AND NIGHT ALL WINTER LONG AND ARE USING THIS WOOD AS THE SOLE FUEL SOURCE. THE PIER SECTIONS ARE STACKED NEXT TO THE FURNACE AND MY PARENTS WITNESSED THEM PUTTING THESE SECTIONS INTO THE FURNACE. THIS COMPANY REMOVES LARGE OLD PIERS (6" X 6" TIMBERS) AND BUILDS NEW PIERS FOR THE SURROUNDING LAKES SO THE POTENTIAL RANGE OF CHEMICALS BEING BURNED AND RELEASED MAY BE BROAD (CHLORINE, ARSENIC, LEAD, MERCURY, DIOXINS ETC). MY COWORKERS ARE EXPERIENCING SIMILAR SYMPTOMS AND ANOTHER HAS BEEN IN THE HOSPITAL. I LIVE 1.5 MILES AWAY AND CAN SMELL THE SAME TOXIC CHEMICAL SMELL AT MY HOUSE. Report DescriptionTHE CALLER STATED THAT A PASSENGER WAS CHARGING THEIR BATTERY ON THEIR CELLPHONE WITHIN THE CABIN OF THE AIRCRAFT WHEN THE LITHIUM BATTERY INSIDE IGNITED. ***WEB REPORT*** ON 06MAY2013, BETWEEN THE HOURS OF 0000-0700 (APPROX.), CGC TAMPA ACCIDENTALLY DISCHARGED 31 GALLONS OF UNLEADED GASOLINE FROM A STORAGE DRUM LOCATED ON THE FANTAIL. REASON FOR DISCHARGE WAS A FAULTY VALVE ON THE STORAGE DRUM. THE CLOSEST POINT OF LAND DURING THAT TIME PERIOD WAS BEACH HAVEN, NEW JERSEY, 52 NM WEST. BOTH WIND AND SEA DIRECTION VARIED BETWEEN 054 DEG TO 072 DEG TRUE, IN A DIRECTION AWAY FROM THE CLOSEST POINT OF LAND. SEA STATE WAS 1 FT, WITH SWELLS AT 4 FT. CGC TAMPA'S SPEED OF ADVANCE WAS 6-7 KTS OVER THE SAME TIME PERIOD. NO PERSONNEL WITNESSED THE SPILL. THE LAST PERSON WAS ON THE FANTAIL AT APPROX. 0000 06MAY13 AND THE SPILL WAS DISCOVERED AT 0700 06MAY13. NO SPILL CONTAINMENT EFFORTS WERE UNDERTAKEN, AS NO VISIBLE SHEEN WAS WITNESSED.
